Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
When you play a political action card, everyone will know which card is
being played, as normal.  You just wouldn't make any decisions involved
unless the vote actually started.  So if you're playing Disputed Territory,
everyone will know it's a DT when deciding whether to block, but wouldn't
know who would be getting what location should the vote pass.  (You can
tell them your intentions while they're deciding whether to block, but
you aren't bound to that...)
